name: Qualify three thermal meta-devices across orthogonal boundary conditions

paper.title: Analytical realization of complex thermal meta-devices

source_experiment_condition_minimum.independent_specimen_count: not reported; must not infer six

stage_semantics: Each stage is a proposal, not an actual task file, simulation, device operation or observation

stages.title: Lock review identity and exclusions
stages.output: revisioned source/hold register
stages.gate: DOI, journal, prior holds and version are consistent
stages.evidence_class: authored workflow organization of source-reported processes and declared additional controls

stages.title: Approve paper-level condition plan
stages.output: condition list covering B01-B12 with experimental/numerical flags
stages.gate: Scope, repeats, controls and admissible observations signed off
stages.evidence_class: authored workflow organization of source-reported processes and declared additional controls

stages.title: Accept qualified design package
stages.input: new original geometry or separately approved verified drawing
stages.output: Per-family design receipt with design_id,design_revision,sample_family_id,units,shape,baseline mapping and fit metadata
stages.gate: C02/C03/C05 disposition and geometry provenance complete for claimed use
stages.evidence_class: authored workflow organization of source-reported processes and declared additional controls

stages.title: Receive materials and tooling identities
stages.output: Material acceptance and tooling manifest attached to the specific family design/job; shared lots may be referenced but never substitute specimen-specific lineage
stages.gate: Specified grades and traceability accepted; unknowns remain held
stages.evidence_class: authored workflow organization of source-reported processes and declared additional controls

stages.title: Produce and release metal lattice
stages.output: Family-specific lattice receipt with design/job/lattice IDs and inspection evidence
stages.gate: Vendor manufacturing work complete; no robot powder or laser control
stages.evidence_class: authored workflow organization of source-reported processes and declared additional controls

stages.title: Produce filled lattice intermediate
stages.input: lattice receipt and approved PDMS lot
stages.output: Family-specific intermediate receipt linking lattice and PDMS lot,core assignment and service job
stages.gate: Service certifies cast/degassed/cured/trimmed intermediate; no recipe exposed
stages.evidence_class: authored workflow organization of source-reported processes and declared additional controls

stages.title: Produce encapsulated specimen
stages.output: Final specimen receipt binding specimen_id,sample_family_id,design_revision,all lattice/intermediate/material parents,nominal envelope and safe-release evidence
stages.gate: Core material correct for family; void/damage/flatness limits qualified
stages.evidence_class: authored workflow organization of source-reported processes and declared additional controls

stages.title: Receive and inspect released specimen
stages.input: dry ambient specimen and release receipt
stages.output: identity/photo/condition/dimension report
stages.gate: All P03-P07 family-specific parent receipts exist and match incoming specimen ID/design revision; geometry,condition and safe handling envelope verified
stages.evidence_class: authored workflow organization of source-reported processes and declared additional controls

stages.title: Qualify calibration and control measurements
stages.output: dated calibration receipt and matched control data
stages.gate: U04/U09/U11 resolved; reference and bare data not confused with simulation
stages.evidence_class: authored workflow organization of source-reported processes and declared additional controls

stages.title: Stage orientation-specific unpowered fixture
stages.output: mount record with orientation transform and slot engagement evidence
stages.gate: Qualified dry/ambient fixture permits touch; placement accepted without forcing
stages.evidence_class: authored workflow organization of source-reported processes and declared additional controls

stages.title: Transfer custody to thermal-test service
stages.output: station acceptance/run ID
stages.gate: Water/electric isolation, permitted envelope and abort channels verified by service
stages.evidence_class: authored workflow organization of source-reported processes and declared additional controls

stages.title: Acquire transient observation series
stages.output: timestamped IR and boundary-sensor stream
stages.gate: No manipulation inside powered zone; no dropped metadata or out-of-envelope state
stages.evidence_class: authored workflow organization of source-reported processes and declared additional controls

stages.title: Review steady-state qualification
stages.output: stable/not-stable decision with reasons
stages.gate: Reported45-minute interval is context; quantitative drift/uncertainty criteria also pass
stages.evidence_class: authored workflow organization of source-reported processes and declared additional controls

stages.title: Acquire registered steady-state result
stages.output: temperature map, line profiles, boundary/ambient record
stages.gate: Coordinate/orientation, calibration, masks and data integrity all valid
stages.evidence_class: authored workflow organization of source-reported processes and declared additional controls

stages.title: Release station and specimen safely
stages.input: Successful acquisition OR failed/aborted/stopped run from any accepted or possibly energized service stage P11-P14
stages.output: zero-energy,cool/dry release and condition report
stages.gate: No handling until service release; abort record kept intact
stages.evidence_class: authored workflow organization of source-reported processes and declared additional controls

entry_contract.required: Service owns stopping,energy isolation and cool/dry qualification; a failure never returns custody to handler automatically
entry_contract.success_exit: P16 only after signed zero-energy,cool/dry release
entry_contract.blocked_exit: SERVICE_CUSTODY_HOLD; no retrieval,rotation,reseat or material disposal
entry_contract.normal_intermediate_success_path: P11 -> P12 -> P13 -> P14; no mandatory release between successful intermediate stages

stages.title: Execute condition/repeat traversal
stages.input: released specimen and remaining run slots
stages.output: new IDs for each rotation,reseat,repeat or replacement
stages.gate: P15 release succeeds,all incoming specimen family-parent receipts are valid,and approved matrix remains; technical repeats never become independent specimens
stages.evidence_class: authored workflow organization of source-reported processes and declared additional controls

stages.title: Reconcile empirical controls
stages.output: control linkage and validity report
stages.gate: Controls match material,boundary,orientation and time conditions; no fabricated reference arrays
stages.evidence_class: authored workflow organization of source-reported processes and declared additional controls

stages.title: Perform qualified result assessment
stages.input: registered measured data and approved metric contract
stages.output: profile comparisons,uncertainty,failures and limitations
stages.gate: C01/C05/U09 resolved for any numeric claim; qualitative result remains distinct
stages.evidence_class: authored workflow organization of source-reported processes and declared additional controls

stages.title: Reconcile broader paper numerical families
stages.input: lawfully sourced or newly qualified result receipts only
stages.output: coverage ledger for B05-B10
stages.gate: Label unrun,unread and unresolved branches; no synthetic result passed as source truth
stages.evidence_class: authored workflow organization of source-reported processes and declared additional controls

stages.title: Close paper-level episode
stages.input: all branch records and safe releases
stages.output: complete/incomplete/aborted decision; archive and custody disposition
stages.gate: Open holds explicitly block affected claims; lineage and cleanup receipts verified
stages.evidence_class: authored workflow organization of source-reported processes and declared additional controls

loops.condition: Next approved orthogonal orientation exists; require safe release and coordinate transform
Approved repeated mount/run remains; new run ID, same specimen ID where appropriate
Next independently identified specimen/device family has complete matching P03-P07 parent receipts; otherwise use L_NEXT_PREPARATION before P08
Approved missing control is feasible; do not fill with simulation
Specimen defect; qualified service creates replacement/rework receipt and new revision; no uncontrolled robot repair
New family/design/revision or missing preparation receipts; complete family-specific P03-P07 before P08

completion_contract: One paper route closes only when required experimental cells, conditional controls, qualified analysis and service/custody closeout have valid evidence or explicit affected-claim holds. No iteration or specimen can inflate paper count.

failure_edges.guard: Mandatory even when no valid dataset exists
